⚠️ BẠN ĐANG MỞ Ở CHẾ ĐỘ XEM TRƯỚC — ÂM THANH SẼ KHÔNG CHẠY
Ứng dụng Tệp (Files) và Zalo trên iPhone chặn JavaScript, nên nút 🔊, chấm điểm và micro đều bị vô hiệu.
👉 Hãy mở bài học bằng đường link https:// mà giáo viên gửi (bấm vào link trong Zalo ➔ chọn biểu tượng la bàn Safari).
Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. cognitive (adj)
/ˈkɒɡnətɪv/
thuộc về nhận thức, tư duy của não bộ (n: cognition — khả năng nhận thức)
Collocation: cognitive development, cognitive function, cognitive decline
"Adequate sleep and bilingual learning play a crucial role in children's cognitive development."
2. anxiety (n)
/æŋˈzaɪəti/
sự lo âu, chứng rối loạn lo âu căng thẳng (adj: anxious — lo âu)
Collocation: suffer from anxiety, acute anxiety, relieve anxiety
"Intense exam pressure and social media comparison can trigger severe anxiety in teenagers."
3. depression (n)
/dɪˈpreʃn/
chứng trầm cảm, sự suy sụp tinh thần (adj: depressed / depressing)
Collocation: clinical depression, combat depression, risk of depression
"Social isolation and chronic overwork increase the risk of clinical depression among young adults."
4. therapy (n)
/ˈθerəpi/
liệu pháp điều trị, trị liệu tâm lý (n: therapist — chuyên gia trị liệu)
Collocation: psychological therapy, cognitive behavioural therapy, undergo therapy
"Seeking professional psychological therapy is an effective way to overcome emotional trauma."
5. resilience (n)
/rɪˈzɪliəns/
khả năng phục hồi tinh thần, sức bền tâm lý vượt qua nghịch cảnh (adj: resilient)
Collocation: build mental resilience, emotional resilience, remarkable resilience
"Outdoor team sports help children build mental resilience and cope with failure."
6. deprivation (n)
/ˌdeprɪˈveɪʃn/
sự thiếu hụt, sự tước đoạt (đặc biệt: sleep deprivation — sự thiếu ngủ trầm trọng)
Collocation: chronic sleep deprivation, suffer from sleep deprivation
"Chronic sleep deprivation impairs memory retention and slows down reaction times."
7. insomnia (n)
/ɪnˈsɒmniə/
chứng mất ngủ
Collocation: suffer from insomnia, chronic insomnia, cure insomnia
"Staring at bright smartphone screens late at night suppresses melatonin and causes insomnia."
8. fatigue (n)
/fəˈtiːɡ/
sự mệt mỏi rã rời, sự kiệt sức (về thể chất hoặc trí óc)
Collocation: mental fatigue, chronic fatigue, driver fatigue
"Working ten hours a day without breaks leads to severe mental fatigue and lower productivity."
9. stimulate (v)
/ˈstɪmjuleɪt/
kích thích, khuấy động (hoạt động não bộ, sự tò mò, kinh tế — n: stimulation)
Collocation: stimulate brain activity, stimulate curiosity, intellectual stimulation
"Playing chess and learning a musical instrument stimulate neural connections in the brain."
10. impair (v)
/ɪmˈpeə(r)/
làm suy giảm, làm tổn hại (khả năng nhận thức, trí nhớ, thị lực, phán đoán)
Collocation: impair cognitive function, impair memory, severely impaired
"Even moderate sleep loss can severely impair a person's judgement and concentration."
11. cope (v)
/kəʊp/
đối phó, đương đầu, xoay xở vượt qua (luôn đi với giới từ WITH: cope with)
Collocation: cope with stress, cope with academic pressure, ability to cope
"Mindfulness meditation teaches employees how to cope with workplace stress calmly."
12. mindfulness (n)
/ˈmaɪndflnəs/
sự chánh niệm, phương pháp rèn luyện sự tập trung tâm trí vào hiện tại
Collocation: practice mindfulness, mindfulness meditation, mindfulness exercises
"Practicing mindfulness for fifteen minutes a day can lower blood pressure and reduce anxiety."
13. overwhelmed (adj)
/ˌəʊvəˈwelmd/
bị quá tải, bị choáng ngợp (bởi khối lượng công việc hoặc cảm xúc)
Collocation: feel overwhelmed by, overwhelmed with work
"Many university freshmen feel overwhelmed by heavy academic assignments and living alone."
14. detrimental (adj)
/ˌdetrɪˈmentl/
có hại, gây tổn hại nghiêm trọng (từ vựng C1 thay thế hoàn hảo cho 'bad / harmful' — đi với TO)
Collocation: detrimental to mental health, have a detrimental effect on
"Excessive screen time before bed has a detrimental effect on sleep quality and mood."
15. wellbeing (n)
/ˈwelbiːɪŋ/
sự khỏe mạnh và hạnh phúc toàn diện (cả thể chất lẫn tinh thần)
Collocation: psychological wellbeing, emotional wellbeing, promote wellbeing
"Progressive companies prioritize their employees' psychological wellbeing to prevent burnout."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Cấu Trúc So Sánh Kép Nhân - Quả 'The More..., The More...' (Comparative Correlatives)

• Công thức chuẩn Band 7.0+ GRA: The + So sánh hơn + S1 + V1, the + So sánh hơn + S2 + V2 (Càng... thì càng...). Đây là cấu trúc cực kỳ hiệu quả để phân tích tác động tâm lý và sức khỏe trong Writing Task 2 và Speaking Part 3:
  - Ví dụ 1: The more time teenagers spend on social media late at night, the more likely they are to suffer from sleep deprivation and anxiety.
  - Ví dụ 2: The earlier schools teach stress management, the more resilient children will become in adulthood.

🔵 Tầng 2: Cụm Tính Từ & Động Từ Tác Động C1 (Be Detrimental To / Enable Sb To V / Impair)

• Nâng cấp câu 'X is bad for Y' (Band 4.5) lên chuẩn C1 (Band 7.5+):
  - X is highly detrimental to Y = X exerts a detrimental impact on Y
    Ví dụ: Chronic sleep deprivation is highly detrimental to cognitive development.
  - enable / empower + Object + to V (Giúp/Trao năng lực cho ai làm gì — thay cho 'help'):
    Ví dụ: Psychological therapy enables patients to cope with severe depression.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. Reading books and solving puzzles play a vital role in stimulating children's ________ development.
2. Many students experience high levels of ________ and nervousness in the week before final exams.
3. Prolonged loneliness and cyberbullying can lead to clinical ________ among vulnerable teenagers.
4. Talking to a trained counsellor in psychological ________ helps patients recover from emotional stress.
5. Facing small challenges in sports helps young people build mental ________ so they do not give up easily.
6. Medical studies show that chronic sleep ________ weakens the immune system and slows down brain function.
7. Drinking coffee late in the evening and scrolling on phones are common causes of ________.
8. Long-distance lorry drivers must take regular rest breaks to prevent accidents caused by driver ________.
9. Interactive science experiments ________ students' curiosity far more effectively than rote memorization.
10. Staying awake for twenty-four hours can ________ a driver's reaction time as badly as alcohol.
11. Schools should teach teenagers practical strategies to ________ with academic pressure and exam stress.
12. Practicing breathing exercises and ________ meditation for ten minutes a day helps calm the mind.
13. When employees are given too many urgent deadlines at once, they quickly feel ________ and exhausted.
14. Working night shifts for many years can be highly ________ to a person's physical and mental health.
15. A four-day workweek can improve employees' psychological ________ without reducing company output.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 23] Responsible readers always ________ breaking news on trusted websites before sharing it.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 22] Public sculptures and green parks enhance the ________ appeal of urban neighbourhoods.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 21] By 2050, the elderly segment is ________ to double to roughly a quarter of the population.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 19] Keeping intelligent marine mammals in small tanks in ________ causes severe psychological stress.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 16] Office workers who lead a ________ lifestyle should exercise daily to prevent obesity.

2. Chronic sleep deprivation is highly detrimental ________ a student's cognitive function and memory.
3. Cognitive behavioural therapy enables patients ________ with severe anxiety and depression effectively.
4. Note the difference between 'cope with' and 'deal with': Many freshmen struggle to cope ________ heavy academic workloads.
5. ________ earlier schools introduce mindfulness classes, the more resilient students will become.
6. Feeling ________ by endless emails and deadlines, many office workers experience chronic mental fatigue.
7. ________ regular physical exercise stimulates brain activity and reduces the risk of clinical depression.
8. Despite ________ eight hours in bed, people who check their phones at midnight still wake up with fatigue.
9. Social media companies are often blamed ________ triggering anxiety among impressionable teenagers.
10. Unless companies respect work-life balance, employee burnout ________ to rise across all industries.

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - The Epidemic of Sleep Deprivation and Insomnia]
Neuroscientists warn that modern society is in the grip of a silent epidemic: chronic sleep deprivation. Whereas adults fifty years ago slept an average of eight hours a night, millions of students and office workers today survive on less than six hours. A primary culprit is the pervasive use of smartphones and laptops in bed. Blue light emitted by screens suppresses melatonin production, triggering insomnia and leaving individuals with severe daytime fatigue.

[Paragraph B - Detrimental Impacts on Cognitive Function and Mental Health]
The consequences of insufficient rest are highly detrimental to both brain performance and emotional stability. During deep sleep, the brain consolidates memories and clears out metabolic toxins. Consequently, chronic sleep loss severely impairs cognitive functions such as attention, problem-solving, and decision-making. Furthermore, the more people feel overwhelmed by relentless academic or workplace pressure without adequate rest, the more vulnerable they become to acute anxiety and clinical depression.

[Paragraph C - Building Resilience Through Therapy, Exercise and Mindfulness]
To safeguard psychological wellbeing, psychologists advocate proactive lifestyle and institutional reforms. On an individual level, establishing a strict 'digital curfew' one hour before bedtime, engaging in physical exercise to stimulate healthy brain chemistry, and practicing daily mindfulness meditation enable people to cope with stress effectively. On a societal level, schools and corporations must provide accessible psychological therapy and reasonable workloads to foster long-term mental resilience.
Điểm: 0/6
